name: Asylum Demon
description: The courtyard boss on the first visit; count the completed fight once.

name: Stray Demon
description: The return-visit boss beneath the courtyard's collapsing floor.

name: Black Knight — Starting cell
description: Sword-wielding knight guarding the route back to the original prison cell on the return visit.

name: Black Knight — Shield hallway
description: Sword-wielding knight replacing the tutorial archer near the hallway where the starting shield was found.

name: Taurus Demon
description: The boss on the rampart between the two towers.

name: Black Knight — Blue Tearstone alley
description: Sword-wielding knight at the end of the alley guarding the Blue Tearstone Ring.

name: Havel the Rock
description: The hostile armored warrior in the watchtower basement connecting the Burg to Darkroot Basin.

name: Hellkite Dragon
description: Kill the dragon perched above the bridge to the Altar of Sunlight; driving it away or cutting its tail does not complete this entry.

name: Bell Gargoyles
description: Defeat both gargoyles on the church roof to complete this single boss encounter.

name: Fang Boar — Parish entrance
description: The armored boar in the courtyard before the portcullis.

name: Black Knight — Tower
description: Greatsword-wielding knight atop the tower before the armored boar courtyard.

name: Berenike Knight — Church altar
description: The non-respawning heavy knight guarding the Fire Keeper Soul inside the church.

name: Channeler — Church balcony
description: The non-respawning Channeler upstairs in the church beside the ambush Hollows.

name: Titanite Demon — Andre's basement
description: The demon in the room below Andre, on the route toward Darkroot Garden.

name: Capra Demon
description: The boss in the small enclosed courtyard at the end of Lower Undead Burg.

name: Gaping Dragon
description: The boss in the large lower chamber; count the completed fight once.

name: Butcher — Large Ember kitchen
description: The butcher chopping meat beside the chest containing the Large Ember.

name: Butcher — Laurentius ambush
description: The second butcher, who drops down near the room where Laurentius is trapped.

name: Giant Undead Rat
description: The single giant rat in the water chamber below the first butcher's kitchen.

name: Channeler — Above Gaping Dragon
description: The non-respawning Channeler on the balcony walkway overlooking the boss arena.

name: Parasitic Wall Hugger
description: The large stationary creature attached to the wall near the Power Within pickup in upper Blighttown.

name: Chaos Witch Quelaag
description: The boss beyond the swamp, guarding the second Bell of Awakening.

name: Moonlight Butterfly
description: The boss on the elevated stone bridge in Darkroot Garden.

name: Great Grey Wolf Sif
description: The boss at Artorias's grave beyond the large sealed door.

name: Great Feline 1 — Forest clearing
description: Track one of the three non-respawning great felines in the forest clearing above the Hydra ladder.

name: Great Feline 2 — Forest clearing
description: Track a second distinct great feline from the same three-enemy forest encounter.

name: Great Feline 3 — Forest clearing
description: Track the remaining great feline from the same three-enemy forest encounter.

name: Black Knight — Grass Crest Shield path
description: Halberd-wielding knight on the lower path near the Grass Crest Shield and the Valley of Drakes tunnel.

name: Hydra — Basin lake
description: The Hydra in the lake beside the waterfall; count the whole creature once.

name: Golden Crystal Golem — Dusk's alcove
description: The golem holding Dusk in the alcove beyond the Hydra's lake; appears after defeating the Hydra and reloading the area.

name: Undead Dragon — Cliffside loot
description: The dragon beside the hanging wooden bridge, guarding the Astora's Straight Sword and Dragon Crest Shield loot.

name: Black Hydra — Lake entrance
description: The Hydra encountered shortly after leaving the Great Hollow; count it once even if it changes sides of the lake.

name: Iron Golem
description: The boss on the rooftop arena leading to Anor Londo.

name: Undead Prince Ricard
description: The hostile rapier-wielding prince on the upper fortress route beyond the heavy knight.

name: Titanite Demon 1 — Near tar-pit pair
description: One of the first two Titanite Demons in the tar pit below the swinging blades.

name: Titanite Demon 2 — Near tar-pit pair
description: The other Titanite Demon in the first pair in the tar pit.

name: Titanite Demon 3 — Far tar-pit pair
description: One of the stronger second pair farther into the tar pit.

name: Titanite Demon 4 — Far tar-pit pair
description: The other Titanite Demon in the stronger second pair in the tar pit.

name: Mimic — Lightning Spear
description: The mimic in the room off the indoor boulder route near the lift; killing it counts, looting it with a talisman does not.

name: Gatekeeper Giant
description: The non-respawning giant behind the illusory wall near the ladder out of the tar pit.

name: Firebomb Giant
description: The non-respawning giant on the highest rooftop, throwing firebombs toward the fortress and boss arena.

name: Ornstein and Smough
description: Complete the entire two-stage fight; the pair awards 5 points total.

name: Dark Sun Gwyndolin
description: The optional boss in the corridor beyond the Darkmoon Tomb.

name: Gargoyle — Elevator side
description: The first lightning gargoyle on the outdoor walkway after descending the arrival elevator.

name: Gargoyle — Cathedral side
description: The second lightning gargoyle on the opposite side of the rotating bridge.

name: Titanite Demon — Chapel
description: The demon in the chapel inside the cathedral residence, across from the drake-head trophy room.

name: Mimic — Crystal Halberd
description: The mimic in the Sentinel hall near the Duke's Archives approach, close to the first bonfire.

name: Mimic — Occult Club cellar
description: The mimic behind the illusory fireplace, among the chests in the cellar containing Havel's equipment.

name: Mimic — Gold Coin
description: The Gold Coin mimic in the upper-floor room by the spiral staircase in the cathedral residence.

name: Mimic — Silver Coins
description: The separate Silver Coin mimic beside the Gold Coin mimic in the upper-floor room.

name: Crossbreed Priscilla
description: The optional boss at the end of the painting; leaving peacefully does not complete the entry.

name: Undead Dragon — Broken bridge
description: The upper body of the undead dragon guarding the broken bridge near the Bloodshield.

name: Mass of Souls 1 — Lower ruins
description: One of the two non-respawning masses inside the main buildings exposed after draining the water.

name: Mass of Souls 2 — Lower ruins
description: The second distinct mass in the other main lower-ruins building; spawned Wisps do not count separately.

name: Four Kings
description: Complete the shared-health boss fight reached from New Londo Ruins; awards 5 points total.

name: Fang Boar 1 — Entrance corridor
description: The first of the two fully armored boars in the corridor before the first Archives bonfire.

name: Fang Boar 2 — Entrance corridor
description: The second distinct fully armored boar before the first Archives bonfire.

name: Golden Crystal Golem — Sieglinde's garden
description: The golem holding Sieglinde in the garden before Crystal Cave; its appearance depends on Siegmeyer's quest progress.

name: Mimic — Crystal Knight Shield
description: The mimic on an upper indoor balcony before the first Seath encounter.

name: Mimic — Enchanted Falchion
description: The mimic in the small library near the descending exit toward the Crystal Golem garden.

name: Seath the Scaleless
description: The final, killable fight in Crystal Cave; the scripted first Archives encounter is not a separate boss entry.

name: Golden Crystal Golem — Main bridge
description: The non-respawning golem on the horizontal crystal bridge along the main route toward Seath; cave lighting makes it appear blue.

name: Golden Crystal Golem — Lower treasure bridge
description: The second non-respawning golem on a lower crystal bridge near a Blue Titanite Chunk corpse.

name: Ceaseless Discharge
description: The boss beyond the first Demon Ruins bonfire, overlooking the lava field.

name: Demon Firesage
description: The boss inside the ruins beyond the demon-filled approach.

name: Centipede Demon
description: The boss in the lower lava arena before the route into Lost Izalith.

name: Minor Taurus Demon 1 — Lava field
description: Track a distinct member (1 of 7) of the non-respawning group on the hardened lava field after Ceaseless Discharge; the three respawning demons near Demon Firesage are excluded.

name: Minor Taurus Demon 2 — Lava field
description: Track a distinct member (2 of 7) of the non-respawning group on the hardened lava field after Ceaseless Discharge; the three respawning demons near Demon Firesage are excluded.

name: Minor Taurus Demon 3 — Lava field
description: Track a distinct member (3 of 7) of the non-respawning group on the hardened lava field after Ceaseless Discharge; the three respawning demons near Demon Firesage are excluded.

name: Minor Taurus Demon 4 — Lava field
description: Track a distinct member (4 of 7) of the non-respawning group on the hardened lava field after Ceaseless Discharge; the three respawning demons near Demon Firesage are excluded.

name: Minor Taurus Demon 5 — Lava field
description: Track a distinct member (5 of 7) of the non-respawning group on the hardened lava field after Ceaseless Discharge; the three respawning demons near Demon Firesage are excluded.

name: Minor Taurus Demon 6 — Lava field
description: Track a distinct member (6 of 7) of the non-respawning group on the hardened lava field after Ceaseless Discharge; the three respawning demons near Demon Firesage are excluded.

name: Minor Taurus Demon 7 — Lava field
description: Track a distinct member (7 of 7) of the non-respawning group on the hardened lava field after Ceaseless Discharge; the three respawning demons near Demon Firesage are excluded.

name: The Bed of Chaos
description: Complete the whole boss encounter; destroying individual side barriers does not award separate points.

name: Pinwheel
description: The boss beyond the Bonewheel Skeleton cavern.

name: Black Knight — Pitfall chamber
description: Greataxe-wielding knight below the pitfall trap near the last Necromancer.

name: Titanite Demon — Gravelord corridor
description: The demon at the end of the long hallway containing the Gravelord Servant coffin.

name: Gravelord Nito
description: The boss reached beyond the lower tomb and Pinwheel Servants.

name: Black Knight — Second bonfire path
description: Halberd-wielding knight along the path near the second bonfire, after the first Skeleton Beast.

name: Sanctuary Guardian
description: The initial DLC boss after the first bonfire; the later respawning Lesser Guardians are excluded.

name: Knight Artorias
description: The boss in the colosseum at the end of Royal Wood.

name: Black Dragon Kalameet
description: The optional dragon boss in the lower valley of Royal Wood.

name: Mimic — Very Good Carving
description: The mimic on the circular tower roof reached around the first bridge section.

name: Mimic — Crest Key fireplace
description: The mimic beside the lit fireplace in the upper room reached by a jump from the wooden walkway.

name: Manus, Father of the Abyss
description: The boss at the bottom of the Chasm of the Abyss.

name: Gwyn, Lord of Cinder
description: The final boss beyond the Kiln; the five respawning Black Knights on the approach are excluded.
